Chapter 1027: Chapter 30 New Homeland, New Era (End of this volume, asking for monthly pass)_2

“Spare you?”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

These subordinates, who followed the two Lords, were stationed outside the cosmos intending to plunder.

Since they wanted to rob others, they naturally had to be prepared for being robbed themselves.

Because Lin Yuan’s own strength was formidable, Bloodshade Lord and Serpent Demon Lord fled without a second thought, looking seemingly innocent.

But what if Lin Yuan had been merely an ordinary Twelfth Layer Path Splitting Realm cultivator?

After painstaking efforts to barely survive the catastrophic collapse of the universe, one might have believed that a bright future awaited—only to be met with cruel plunderers.

At that time, would these plunderers have had any shred of compassion for Lin Yuan?

Lin Yuan’s gaze swept across, utilizing the Mind Will Secret Skill, “Abyssal Eye.” Soul Searching Lord Realm experts proved somewhat difficult, but searching the souls of these Path Splitting Realm beings was relatively simple.

“Bloodshade Lord? Serpent Demon Lord?”

Lin Yuan immediately obtained intelligence on these two Lords—a pair of notorious, domineering overlords. Despite their poor reputations, their strength was unfathomable. Even the Serpent Demon Lord possessed power nearing the peak of Lordship.

“These treasures…”

After eliminating the numerous subordinates of the two Lords, Lin Yuan began inventorying the loot.

What he discovered slightly surprised him—the spoils of the two Lords were overwhelming. Bloodshade Lord possessed two treasures from the Chaos Realm—one offensive and one defensive—along with other rare treasures.

The total value exceeded six hundred thousand Chaos Stones.

As for the Serpent Demon Lord, he too carried two Chaos Realm treasures, though his other valuables and curiosities were slightly less impressive. Altogether, they were worth about five hundred thousand Chaos Stones.

In total, the two Lord Realm experts had contributed treasures worth over a million Chaos Stones.

“They were truly wealthy.”

Lin Yuan sighed slightly. Even a peak Lord Realm expert like ‘Cang Weiyang’ only had total assets worth around three hundred to four hundred thousand Chaos Stones.

“Indeed, plundering is the simplest way to acquire resources,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Bloodshade Lord was a notorious raider, having pillaged numerous cosmoses before settling at his home cosmos. Coupled with his earlier accumulations, his wealth naturally surpassed that of ‘Cang Weiyang.’

The Serpent Demon Lord, though weaker, had also amassed riches through similar plundering methods, surpassing ‘Cang Weiyang’ in accumulated wealth.

“Resources for the perfected Twelfth Layer Lord Realm ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ are nearly complete.”

After a brief calculation, Lin Yuan determined that the combined resources of the two Lords—over a million Chaos Stones—added to his existing holdings, were sufficient to cultivate the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ Secret Technique to its perfected Lord Realm.

With ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ reaching the perfected Lord Realm, Lin Yuan’s physical strength would surge dramatically again, making the power behind his every movement even more terrifying.

Moreover, the physical body nurtures the soul and the mind’s will. Strengthening the body would greatly benefit the soul and mind’s will.

“Unknowingly, I have become so powerful?” Lin Yuan mused while organizing the spoils, putting away the black warship and floating island.

When he first explored the Chaos Void, even stumbling upon the remnants of a dwelling left by Lord Realm expert ‘Cang Weiyang’ required extreme caution and vigilance.

And now, how much time had passed? The Bloodshade Lord and Serpent Demon Lord, both at nearly the same level as ‘Cang Weiyang,’ could be suppressed by Lin Yuan with a mere flick of his hand.

The stark contrast between then and now left Lin Yuan filled with emotion.

…

“These two Lords, along with their peak Path Splitting Realm subordinates, haven’t completely perished? Do they still possess life-saving contingencies?”

Lin Yuan briefly followed the trail of causal sensing.

This was entirely expected. Let alone peak Path Splitting Realm beings—even those who had just entered the Path Splitting Realm could set up life-saving mechanisms.

Why were Chaos Venerables notoriously hard to kill? It was because even Great Saints struggled to obliterate all of a Venerable’s life-saving contingencies.

Yet, through their profound understanding of causality, Chaos Venerables could effortlessly eliminate all life-saving measures of Lord Realm experts if they so desired.

This was precisely why Lord Realm experts felt so fearful and submissive before Venerables.

…

Within a fragment of an asteroid drifting in the Chaos Void, a figure swiftly condensed—it was Bloodshade Lord.

In this fragmentary asteroid, he had left a life-saving contingency. Whenever his true body perished, he could resurrect here.

“I actually died at the hands of a Venerable…” Bloodshade Lord’s heart sank, chilled to the core. He had no time to ponder why a Venerable would emerge from within the universe.

“I’m going to die.”

Bloodshade Lord was utterly despairing; if a Chaos Venerable so wished, they could entirely erase all his resurrection mechanisms through causal connections.

Thus, when Bloodshade Lord resurrected, he was already prepared for complete annihilation.

Yet, after waiting in hopeless dread for half a day, Bloodshade Lord discovered—he hadn’t died.

“Could it be that the Venerable finds me beneath notice?” Bloodshade Lord heaved a bitter sigh of relief. Erasing a Lord Realm expert’s life-saving contingencies through causality was an onerous task, even for Chaos Venerables.

If no resentment was involved, Chaos Venerables typically didn’t bother.

“Leave, leave, immediately leave this Void!”

Without hesitation, Bloodshade Lord bolted, flying away from Lin Yuan’s position at great speed.

The causal link between him and Lin Yuan would blur with increasing distance. To the Bloodshade Lord, he was nothing more than an ant before the Venerable.

If the Venerable couldn’t see him, they likely wouldn’t bother acting. But if the causal proximity were too close, there was no guarantee Lin Yuan wouldn’t suddenly decide to eliminate him out of convenience.

Thus…

To live longer, Bloodshade Lord could only keep away from Lin Yuan.

“Leave, leave, I’ll never again approach this Void…”
